$description: Card's tokens (plan 0006 §0s). The build generates styles/components/kinds/card.css and card.generated.ts from the card group.

card.$description: Each variant is a surface role read from the family in scope; data-surface picks the family. Old presets map to family + role: default → elevated; glass → glass + deep; flat → flat + minimal; matte → neuro + solid; stark → stark + glow; a preset id <family>-<role> → that family + role.

disabled.$description: Card.svelte's disabled classes (pointer-events-none opacity-60), now from the disabled state.
